_meta.description: Data table manifest for the SDC platform. Generated from Workato Data Table JSON exports. Two project scopes: Base (workspace-level orchestration) and Data collection (per-client WFA tables).
notes: Workato API exposes both short-text and long-text as 'string'. Fields originating from long-text are tagged [long-text] in their hint.
System fields (Record ID, Created time, Last modified time) are auto-managed by Workato and omitted from schema definitions.
Relation columns are in deferred_relations — they require a two-pass provisioning strategy (create tables first, add relations second).
Field order within each table matches the source export and reflects intended column display order.
file-type fields (e.g., upload_from_ui) are Workato-native file attachment columns.

changes: Full rebuild from live Workato Data Table JSON exports.
Two-project structure: Base (HOME_*, MAIN_*) and Data collection (CFG_*, VER_*, WFA_*, RUN_*).
Added RUN_ManualEntry (EAV store for WFA form data).
WFA_SupplierRequest now includes: 20 dynamic form slots (8 text, 2 num, 2 bool, 4 sel, 4 date) with paired _label fields, upload_from_ui (file), customer_name, seed data fields.
CFG_Field expanded: must_be_empty, column_unique, data_cleaning_flags, field_length_validation, numeric_field_validation, date_field_validation, field_input_validation, strict, visible, control_type.
Deferred relations now include RUN_ManualEntry → WFA_SupplierRequest and RUN_FieldError → CFG_Field.

type_reference.string [long-text]: Workato long-text. Effectively unlimited. Flagged in hint.
type_reference.boolean: Workato boolean. Default false unless noted.
type_reference.relation: Workato relation column. Deferred — requires target table to exist first.

schema.name: version_number

tables.name: CFG_Field
tables.purpose: Column-level field definitions. Drives validation rules, template generation, and form slot derivation. Immutable within a version.

schema.name: field_id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID).

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.template_version_id. Immutable.

schema.name: field_name
schema.hint: Column name in the upload template. Immutable within a version.

schema.name: description
schema.hint: Human-readable field description.

schema.name: data_type
schema.hint: Expected type: string | integer | date | decimal | boolean.

schema.name: data_format
schema.hint: Expected data shape (e.g., 'MM/DD/YYYY', 'ISO-8601').

schema.name: required
schema.hint: Whether the field must have a value.

schema.name: must_be_empty
schema.hint: If true, this field must be blank in submissions. Used for system-managed or read-only columns.

schema.name: column_unique
schema.hint: Whether values must be unique across all rows.

schema.name: data_cleaning_flags
schema.hint: Serialized cleaning directives (e.g., 'trim,uppercase').

schema.name: position
schema.hint: Column display/processing order.

schema.name: lookup_name
schema.hint: Soft join → CFG_Lookup.lookup_name (scoped by shared template_version_id). Name-based by convention.

schema.name: depends_on
schema.hint: FK → CFG_Field.field_id of the parent field in a cascading dropdown.

schema.name: field_length_validation
schema.hint: Character count limits for text fields (e.g., 'min:1,max:50').

schema.name: numeric_field_validation
schema.hint: Mathematical boundaries for numeric fields (e.g., 'min:0,max:999999').

schema.name: date_field_validation
schema.hint: Chronological boundaries for date fields (e.g., 'min:2020-01-01,max:today').

schema.name: field_input_validation
schema.hint: Input validation as a regular expression.

schema.name: strict
schema.hint: Does a single-field validation failure reject the entire row? Defaults to false if null.

schema.name: visible
schema.hint: Whether this field appears on the WFA intake form. Used by CFG_FormSlot generation.

schema.name: control_type
schema.hint: WFA widget type (e.g., text, dropdown, date). Derived from data_type and lookup_name during form slot generation.

tables.name: CFG_Lookup

schema.name: project_specific

schema.name: rule
schema.hint: Verb or phrase defining the cross-field relationship (e.g., 'must_equal', 'required_when').

schema.name: condition_field

schema.name: condition_field_id

deferred_relations._comment: Pass 2: Add relation-type display columns after all tables exist. These are Workato UI helpers — not real FK constraints. The recipe resolves table_id and field_id from the Pass 1 results map.

add_column.name: field_name_display
add_column.hint: Relation → CFG_Field. Displays field_name for UI readability.

add_column.name: supplier_request_id
add_column.hint: Relation → WFA_Supplier_request. Scopes rows to a single request. Used by WFA table widget as relatedColumnId.

add_column.name: field_name_display
add_column.hint: Relation → CFG_Field. Displays field_name for UI readability.
